## Details

<a id="shape_buffer3_part8"></a>
### [`shape_buffer3_part8`](../../../../src/graphics/bull_sprites_c900.asm#L6) `$C900-$C93F`

*variable*

Last block of shape buffer 3 (VIC pointer $24). The file holds 64 bytes of uninitialised RAM here, and the shape builder overwrites them.

<a id="bull_f62_parts"></a>
### [`bull_f62_parts`](../../../../src/graphics/bull_sprites_c900.asm#L16) `$C940-$C9BF`

*data*

Bull parts, VIC pointers $25-$2f. The bull round shows them directly: shape_page_offset is not 0, so $3914 takes the pointers from the part tables ($3b95). These 11 blocks are the v1 bull parts $e0-$ea ($f800-$fabf), byte for byte.
VIC pointers $25-$26: bull frames 62,70,75 (anim $1c,$1e).
